correctness.rationale: Existence half verifies: the stated representative face-traces (two independent tracers) to exactly 16 faces of length 4 covering all 64 darts, hence genus (2-12+32-16)/2=3, minimum by the F<=16 degree argument. Completeness (N=1) is FALSE. Step 2 invalidly promotes the pointwise quad-closure identity sigma_a(sigma_{a1}(b))=b at the single label b to the permutation identity sigma_a o sigma_{a1} = id over all 8 points; the fiber/involution/2+2 reduction and the 256-family normalization therefore do not follow. Explicit counterexample (orientation-preserving rotation systems): rotA=[[6,3,1,4,7,5,2,0],[6,0,1,3,2,7,4,5],[1,0,7,2,5,4,3,6],[3,4,1,6,5,7,0,2]], rotB=[[0,3,2,1],[1,2,3,0],[2,1,3,0],[1,0,2,3],[2,1,0,3],[3,1,2,0],[2,0,1,3],[0,1,2,3]] face-traces under both faceutil.faces and an independently coded dart tracer to 16 faces all of length 4 (proper 4-cycles, 64 darts covered), hence a second minimum-genus quadrangular embedding. It is not Aut-equivalent to the representative: the number of distinct A-successor perms (exact equality) is 4 versus 2 for the representative, an invariant under (pa,pb) since pb acts by simultaneous conjugation and pa only permutes labels; a pruned exhaustive isomorphism search over all 24 pa x 8 pb-shifts determined by the A0 row finds no map, and its B-rotations realize four cyclic classes outside {gamma,gamma^-1}. Hence at least two classes exist and N=1 is disproved. TARGET route: target question is well-formed, no ADMISSION_DEFECT.

The nearest prior is the enumeration of minimum-genus orientable embeddings of K_{m,n} for 2<=m,n<=7 except (7,7), which by its stated scope excludes K(4,8). General results found (Ringel/Bouchet genus formula, regular/reflexible embedding classifications of K_{n,n}, Korzhik quadrangular work on K_n, Conder-Stokes search methods, Shao-Liu-Li genus-embedding counts) give existence/formulas or restricted symmetric classes, not the exact unrestricted census count N for K(4,8). No table, database, or theorem found states or substantively implies N=1 (or any exact N) for K(4,8). Hence the headline census claim is not previously recorded or mechanically implied; originality PASSES even though the claim is false (falsity is scored under correctness, not priority).
